highlights.title: Lists on the phone
highlights.detail: On a phone, each table shows as a list. Each row shows the name and the amount on the first line. The date, category, account and other details are on the second line. You do not scroll sideways, and the page scrolls as one.

highlights.title: Sort and load more
highlights.detail: Use Sort by and the order button above each list. Each list shows 50 rows. Tap Show more to see the next 50.
